==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A Bat Knight attacked us in a Wind World in the Storyverse. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.) (Bat Knights are humanoid vampire bats dressed in purple knight's armor with a bat insignia on the chest. After consuming the blood of a Lucid Light cow, they possess the power to wield Lucid Light.) (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (The Wind World is a world where the wind is fast, dangerous, destructive, and constant. If you're tough enough and can fly, the wind can help you move faster.)
I created a wind elemental that snatched away the Bat Knight's amulet, causing the knight to become human. (The Bat Knight amulet is a glowing amethyst bat shaped necklace. It allows the wearer to assume multiple batlike forms.)
The knight perished in the razor winds and Second Brain now possesses the Were-Bat amulet.
